features.description: Land the schema + metadata layer for skill applicability. Two halves: (a) bump agent-conventions plan.schema.json to v1.5.0 to add `surfaces: list[str]` with enum `["web", "ios", "android", "backend", "infra", "security", "data", "ux", "ml", "docs"]` (optional, backward-compatible — plans without the field still validate). Subtree-pull into DontPanic at `claude/shared/`, regenerate `claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/models/plan_model.py` Pydantic model, update `dontpanic_orchestrate.plan_loader` to surface the field through `LoadedPlan`. (b) Document `applies_to:` SKILL.md frontmatter shape — a dict with `surfaces: [...]` (subset of the same enum) + `goal_types: [...]` (subset of plan-schema goal_type enum) plus optional inert `external_cli: {provider, name, command, version_pin}` metadata for externally-backed skills. SKILL.md has no strict schema; the matcher in F002 validates the block via Pydantic. Add `claude/skills/SKILL_APPLIES_TO.md` documenting the schema + when each surface applies. Backfill `surfaces:` on 3 representative existing plans (one mechanical/infra surface, one ux surface, one backend surface — pick from the active or completed list). Backfill `applies_to:` on 5 representative existing skills covering distinct surfaces. NOT all 30 skills — backfill is demonstrative; the rest opt in over time. F001 ships zero behavior change beyond schema acceptance + Pydantic regeneration.
steps: Read current `claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/plan.schema.json` to confirm shape; verify `additionalProperties: false` is set at the root (it is, per F001 investigation — schema bump required).

In agent-conventions repo: edit `schemas/v1.0/plan.schema.json` adding `surfaces` property under the root properties block, with `type: array, items: { enum: [10 values] }` and `description` citing v1.5.0 + this plan.
Bump `agent-conventions/VERSION` to `1.5.0`. Commit in agent-conventions.
Subtree-pull agent-conventions into `claude/shared/` of DontPanic — same pattern as F023 EC1's v1.3.0 pull.
Regenerate `claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/models/plan_model.py` from the bumped schema (use existing `datamodel-codegen` invocation; check for any other generated models that need refresh).

Update `dontpanic_orchestrate.plan_loader.LoadedPlan` dataclass to expose `surfaces: list[str]` (default `[]`) — mirrors how `target_env` / `target_project` are surfaced from the underlying `Plan` model.

Backfill `surfaces:` on three existing plans — pick: (a) `2026-05-01-004-feat-patch-completeness-gate` → `["infra", "security"]`; (b) `2026-05-01-005-feat-target-context-platform-fix` → `["infra"]`; (c) one ux-flavored plan (search for ux in plan titles).

Add `claude/skills/SKILL_APPLIES_TO.md` documenting the optional frontmatter shape with examples + when to use each surface. Include the optional inert `external_cli:` sub-block with `provider`, `name`, `command`, and `version_pin`, and state that v0 records the metadata but never installs or invokes the CLI. The doc is the source of truth for skill authors.

Backfill `applies_to:` on 5 skills picked to span surfaces and to prove the motivating UX/design case: `pr-reviewer` → `["backend", "infra"]`, `eval-harness` → `["ml", "ux"]`, `changelog` → `["docs"]`, `cost-model` → `["infra"]`, and `browser-use` or `agent-browser` → `["web", "ux"]`. Each skill gets `goal_types:` declared too (e.g., pr-reviewer applies broadly; eval-harness applies to new_feature/parity).

Add `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_plan_surfaces_field.py` asserting: (a) plan with `surfaces:` validates and surfaces[] reaches `LoadedPlan`; (b) plan without `surfaces:` still validates (backward-compat); (c) plan with invalid surface value fails validation cleanly; (d) the schema version is `1.5.0` (read from `claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/plan.schema.json` `$id` or sibling VERSION file).
Run full orchestrate test sweep — must stay ≥ 1445 passed (post-2026-05-08-001 baseline).

features.description: Lock-time advisory matcher. New module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/skill_applicability.py` with pure-function `match(plan: LoadedPlan, skills_dir: Path) -> ApplicabilityReport`. Reads each `<skills_dir>/<name>/SKILL.md`, parses YAML frontmatter, validates `applies_to:` block via Pydantic (skips skills lacking the field with a one-line 'skill has no applies_to' Skip entry), matches against `plan.surfaces` (set intersection) and `plan.goal_type` (membership check). Returns `ApplicabilityReport(schema_version='1.0', plan_id, plan_surfaces, plan_goal_type, matches, skipped)`. Each `Match`: `(skill_name, matched_surfaces, matched_goal_types, rationale, provenance, external_cli)`, where provenance is `internal` unless the skill declares `applies_to.external_cli`, in which case provenance is `external` and external_cli is copied as inert metadata. Each `Skip`: `(skill_name, reason)`. Wire into `dontpanic plan lock` (D003 — investigation will confirm seam): on successful lock, call `match()` and write `<plan_dir>/evidence/applicable-skills.json`. Operator-facing output: one line. NO blocking, NO gate, NO CLI execution. Tests: purity contract, match correctness across surface combos, skip-no-applies_to, empty-surfaces plan, malformed applies_to, external-provenance pass-through, JSON round-trip. NOT in v0: scope-change re-probe (memory's v0 lock).
steps: Investigate the right invocation seam: `dontpanic plan lock` exists today (per goal-governance F1). Confirm it's the canonical lock entry for both goal-gated and non-goal-gated plans, and that adding a post-lock hook there doesn't conflict with the sufficiency_gate flow.

Add `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/skill_applicability.py` exporting `match(plan, skills_dir)`, the `ApplicabilityReport` dataclass, `Match` / `Skip` dataclasses, and a private `_parse_applies_to(frontmatter: dict) -> AppliesTo | None` Pydantic-validated parser.

Define dataclasses (frozen, with `to_dict`/`from_dict` for round-trip). `ExternalCli(provider: str, name: str, command: str, version_pin: str)` and `AppliesTo(surfaces: list[str], goal_types: list[str], external_cli: ExternalCli | None = None)` — frontmatter-side. `Match` + `Skip` + `ApplicabilityReport` per F002 description, including `provenance: Literal['internal', 'external']` and optional `external_cli` on matches.

Match logic: for each skill, parse frontmatter; if no `applies_to:` block, emit Skip with reason 'skill has no applies_to declaration'. Else compute `matched_surfaces = set(plan.surfaces) & set(applies_to.surfaces)` and `matched_goal_types = {plan.goal_type} & set(applies_to.goal_types)` (latter empty if plan has no goal_type). A Match emits when EITHER surface intersection OR goal_type intersection is non-empty. Rationale is a one-liner: 'matched on surfaces=[ux,backend] + goal_types=[]' or similar. If `applies_to.external_cli` is present, set `provenance='external'` and copy the metadata; otherwise `provenance='internal'`.

Wire into `dontpanic plan lock`: after the existing lock flow completes successfully (sufficiency gate passes, status flips to active), call `match()` and persist `<plan_dir>/evidence/applicable-skills.json`. On any matcher exception (file read, parse, etc.), log a warning and continue — best-effort, NEVER block lock.
Operator output: print one line `[applicable-skills] {N} matches, {M} skips written to evidence/applicable-skills.json` after successful lock.
Tests — purity contract (source-grep): `subprocess`, `logging.getLogger`, `print(` not present in module source.

Tests — match correctness: parametrized over (a) plan with surfaces=['ux'] + skill applies_to.surfaces=['ux'] → match; (b) plan with surfaces=['backend'] + skill applies_to.surfaces=['ux','ml'] → no match (no surface overlap), no goal_type overlap → no match; (c) plan with goal_type='new_feature' + skill applies_to.goal_types=['new_feature'] → match even with surface=[]; (d) plan with neither surfaces nor goal_type → empty matches list.
Tests — skip path: skill without `applies_to:` frontmatter → Skip entry with reason; matcher does NOT crash.
Tests — malformed applies_to: skill with `applies_to: 'not a dict'` or `applies_to: { surfaces: 'not a list' }` → Skip with reason citing parse failure; matcher does NOT crash.
Tests — empty-surfaces plan: plan with no `surfaces:` and no `goal_type` → empty matches list (no false positives).

Tests — external provenance: skill with valid `applies_to.external_cli` matching on surface emits a Match with `provenance='external'` and copies provider/name/command/version_pin; matcher does not run the command (source-grep purity guard plus no subprocess).
Tests — JSON round-trip: serialize ApplicabilityReport to JSON, parse back, assert equality. Pins envelope shape for future schema-promotion work.
Run full sweep + ruff check. Manually verify `dontpanic plan lock` on a backfilled plan from F001 produces a sidecar with sensible matches.
Add D-entry summarizing v0 disposition + the future-v1 trigger conditions (real false-positive data, scope-change re-probe demand).
features.acceptance: (1) `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/skill_applicability.py` exists with `match(plan, skills_dir)` exported. (2) Module is pure-function (auditor verifies via source grep — no subprocess, no logging side-effects, no print). (3) `ApplicabilityReport(schema_version, plan_id, plan_surfaces, plan_goal_type, matches, skipped)` envelope with `Match` + `Skip` dataclasses; Match includes `provenance: internal|external` and optional `external_cli`; JSON round-trip works (test pins shape). (4) Match logic: surface intersection OR goal_type intersection triggers a Match; neither → Skip if no applies_to OR omit from output if applies_to present but no overlap. (5) Skills without `applies_to:` are Skipped with rationale; matcher never crashes on missing/malformed frontmatter. (6) Valid `applies_to.external_cli` metadata is validated and copied into matching report entries without installing, invoking, or allowlisting the command. (7) `dontpanic plan lock` writes `<plan_dir>/evidence/applicable-skills.json` after successful lock; matcher errors are logged-and-continue, NEVER block. (8) Operator-facing output is one line summarizing N matches / M skips. (9) Test coverage: parametrized match correctness (4+ cases), skip-no-applies_to, malformed-applies_to, empty-surfaces, external-provenance pass-through, JSON round-trip — all green. (10) NO blocking behavior — auditor verifies by attempting `dontpanic plan lock` on a fixture plan with no matching skills; lock still succeeds with status:active flip. (11) NO scope-change re-probe code in F002 — locked-out per memory's v0 design + future-v1 trigger documented in D-entry. (12) All existing orchestrate test modules stay green (≥ 1445 passed).
